label: CMITech Iris SDK (EF-45NC / EF-70 / EFM-45/70 / BMT-20 / EMX-30)
_comment: CMITech (cmi-tech.com) ships its iris enrollment SDK behind the members-only 'Bulletin for F/W' area of their site — there is NO public direct download. Obtain IrisTect.dll (exact vendor file name may differ per SDK version; add all candidates to 'dlls') from sales@cmi-tech.com or your distributor, drop it together with THIS file into enrollment-bridge\sdk\ (or SDK_DIR), then POST /sdk/rescan (the web app does this automatically via the 'بازجستجو' button). If the vendor export names differ from the ones probed here, adjust 'probe'/'open'/'close'/'capture' to match the SDK header — the bridge captures any DLL whose exports are described by this declarative manifest, so no code change is needed.
